sources.snippet: Qwen3-4B-2507-abliterated-GGUF The Huihui-Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-abliterated model is an uncensored, proof-of-concept version of the Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 large language model, created using a novel abliteration method designed to remove refusal responses without using TransformerLens.
